name: MIRIX
summary: Open-source multi-agent memory system: six memory types (core, episodic, semantic, procedural, resource, knowledge vault) managed by dedicated agents, with optional screen capture.
description: Run the backend and dashboard with Docker Compose, create an API key in the dashboard and use the Python client (`pip install mirix-client`) to give an assistant long-term memory built from conversations and, optionally, continuous screen observation. Long-term data is stored locally; search uses PostgreSQL-native BM25 full-text plus vector similarity. Inputs can be text, images, voice and screen captures. Described in arXiv 2507.07957.
